name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
summary: Kerlonian Evershade struggles to stay awake on the road from Darkshore to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. Newly awakened from a long sleep, he carries the Horn of Awakening and needs help against furbolgs and cultists along the way.

sections.title: A Slumbering Mind
sections.body: Kerlonian Evershade, a Druid of the Claw, has only recently awakened from sleep in the barrows. For millennia, the druids communed with wild spirits through the Emerald Dream. The Third War called them to wake, but centuries of hibernation leave Kerlonian struggling to stay conscious. He set out south from Darkshore to meet Liladris Moonriver in Ashenvale, yet exhaustion soon overtook him. Sudden naps leave him helpless along the wilds, so he depends on a brass Horn of Awakening and passing allies to keep moving.

sections.title: Peril Along the Road
sections.body: The road from Darkshore into Ashenvale holds danger for Kerlonian. In Twilight Vale, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs stalk the roadway. Farther south in Ashenvale, members of the Dark Strand cult lie in ambush. Kerlonian may lie down wherever he stands when sleep takes him, so you need to keep watch and rouse him with the horn.

sections.title: Arrival at the Outpost
sections.body: Kerlonian Evershade reaches Maestra's Post after surviving the ambushes, then slips away to find a patch of grass for his interrupted nap. Liladris Moonriver, his contact, greets him with fond exasperation and little surprise at his dazed state. The waking world still jars many druids after the timeless quiet of the Dream.

faq.q: Why does Kerlonian keep falling asleep?
faq.answer: Kerlonian Evershade keeps falling asleep because he only recently woke from centuries of hibernation in the Emerald Dream. The waking world leaves many druids disoriented and lethargic, and he struggles to stay awake without being roused.

faq.q: How do you wake Kerlonian up when he naps?
faq.answer: You can wake Kerlonian with the Horn of Awakening, found in a chest beside him when the journey begins. When he falls asleep along the trail, blow the horn to rouse him so he can continue.

faq.q: Who is waiting for Kerlonian at Maestra's Post?
faq.answer: Liladris Moonriver is waiting for Kerlonian at Maestra's Post in northern Ashenvale. She knows his chronic sleepiness and is relieved to see him arrive safely.

faq.q: What enemies attack along the way?
faq.answer: Blackwood furbolgs attack near Twilight Vale. Farther south in Ashenvale, excavators, adepts, and cultists of the Dark Strand strike from the shadows.

faq.q: Where does the title 'The sleeper has awakened' come from?
faq.answer: The words “The sleeper has awakened” are a greeting spoken by Druids of the Claw when called into service during the Third War. They point to Kerlonian's nature as an awakened shapeshifter.

faq.q: What happens to the horn if you take too long?
faq.answer: The Horn of Awakening vanishes from your possessions after a limited time. If the escort takes too long or must begin again after a failure, gather a replacement from the chest at Kerlonian's resting spot.

angles.text: As a druid, you know deep communion with the Emerald Dream can take a heavy toll. Long hibernation can leave the waking mind slow to regain full consciousness.
As a night elf, you share in the upheaval of Kerlonian's people. Thousands of druids answered the horn during the Third War and now adjust to daylight.
As an Alliance traveler, you help keep communication open between Auberdine and the outlying sentry posts by helping travelers pass safely between Darkshore and northern Ashenvale.
